# eVault packaging assets

Reference assets for the upstream eVault desktop distribution:

- Launch4j configuration for Windows and macOS packaging
- Shell launcher
- Application icons
- Screenshots used by the [application README](../README.md)

This directory does not contain a bundled Java runtime or Windows executable. Adjust runtime paths and build the application before using the packaging configuration.

For historical upstream releases, see [MHISoft eVault releases](https://github.com/mhisoft/eVault/releases).
